description: This file defines an interface for search-related operations in the shopizer project, including indexing products, deleting indexes, searching for keywords, and performing product searches.

classes.name: SearchService
classes.description: Interface for search operations such as indexing products, deleting indexes, keyword search, product search, and initializing the search service.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Indexes a product for a specific merchant store, should be invoked when a product is created or updated.

methods.name: deleteIndex
methods.description: Deletes the index for a product in the store, should be invoked when a product is deleted.

methods.name: searchForKeywords
methods.description: Searches for keyword suggestions based on a character series, used for autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a product search based on user input, with support for language, pagination, and search criteria.

methods.name: initService
methods.description: Initializes the search service to avoid lazy initialization issues.
